kashika: आमन्त्रितप्रथमाया यदेकवचनं तत् संबुद्धिसंज्ञं भवति। हे पटो। हे देवदत्त। संबुद्धिप्रदेशाः — <<एङ्ह्रस्वात् संबुद्धेः>> [[६.१.६९]] इत्येवमादयः॥
kashikaEnglish: The vocative singular is called sambuddhi: हे राम (the म् is elided).
englishShort: The प्रथमा-एकवचन when used in the context of  सम्बोधन gets the term  'सम्बुद्धि'.
englishFull:
In the vocative, the singular of the 1st case-affix is called सम्बुद्धि.

This term enables rules like @ref[6.1.69], which elides a consonant after एङ् or short vowel when सम्बुद्धि follows.

**Example:**
हे राम — The सु of nominative becomes सम्बुद्धि in vocative singular.
